name: Arboretum
summary: Card-laying arboretum builder where hand cards determine who may score each color's ascending paths.
rules_text: Use 6/8/10 suits of 1-8 for 2/3/4 players. Deal 7 cards each, rest as draw pile. Each player has face-up arboretum and discard. On your turn draw 2 cards, each from top of draw pile or top of any player's discard, then play 1 card from hand orthogonally adjacent to your arboretum, then discard 1 to your own pile, ending with 7 in hand. When draw pile empties, current player finishes turn and game ends. For each suit, player with highest sum of that suit in hand gains right to score; tied highest all gain it; if no one has suit, all gain it; an 8 counts as 0 if an opponent holds the 1 of same suit. Scoring: a path is orthogonally connected ascending values where first and last share the scored suit, interior any suit. Score path length, +1 per card if length>=4 and all same suit, +1 if starts with 1, +2 if ends with 8. Score only one best path per suit you earned.
rating_reason: Colorful card tableau, hand management, scoring via arithmetic.
reasons: scope: spatial_board: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)
